## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-cinematic-world-stills`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-cinematic-world-stills -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `metadata.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `metadata.jsonl`
- `harness-plugin.jpg`
- `coliseum-plunge.jpg`
- `council-os-lobby.jpg`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/cinematic-world-stills at revision `fd49c1ab12a1a11f6fc13a7b8bbad465d5ebc8ff`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# Council of AI — cinematic stills

Cinematic stills produced for Council of AI surfaces. `metadata.jsonl` gives the
Hub image viewer a caption per file. These are illustrations — they carry no measurement and back no slot.

## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `coliseum-plunge.jpg` | 77851 |  | image |
| `council-os-lobby.jpg` | 64478 |  | image |
| `harness-plugin.jpg` | 44004 |  | image |
| `README.md` | 1561 |  | card |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 5 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |
| `metadata.jsonl` | | 3 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.jsonl` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
